title: War of the Spark Promos: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: The sky boiled over the citadel, dire and dark. Then the angels brought the dawn.
"If you can't save yourself, you fight to give someone else a chance." —Ajani Goldmane
The heart of Ravnica disappeared before anyone could strike a blow in its defense.
Not even a threat to the entire Multiverse could persuade them to put aside their feud.
"Some bend the law. I tie it into knots."
"There is no future save the one my master wills."
"Even gods shall kneel." —Nicol Bolas
Ugin saw the gem that connected Bolas to his Meditation Realm as the key to his brother's downfall.
"In the disarray of battle, an enemy's attack may be your most convenient weapon." —Narset
Liliana seized the reins of Bolas's vast army, gritting her teeth behind the Chain Veil.
The path to power is often paved with atrocities.
When you rule by fear, your greatest weakness is one who's no longer afraid.
"After the people flee, but before the enemy arrives—that's grabbin' time."
The Eternal armies advanced on Vitu-Ghazi. At Nissa's command, Vitu-Ghazi advanced on them.
Some spells sing a quiet tune. Others roar.
"There are many kinds of duty, and mine is to see our world grow and endure."
"I see you've learned nothing, Chandra. You'd still put a match to something rather than understand it."
"The ancient places of Ravnica awaken, stirred by the hoofbeats of Ilharg!" —Nikya of the Old Ways
"So everyone gets what they truly deserve, I will keep watch."

Uthlon the Wise scandalized sphinx society, hooting the answers to riddles as he rampaged through Tin Street. Grangle, on the other hand, sat for hours, deep in thought, largely ignored by fellow goblins.
"The primary weapon is nothing more than light. It shows them what they are, and they burn of their own accord." —Aurelia
As the Eternal's cold fingers tightened around his throat, Domri realized what kind of master he had rushed to serve.
In times of war, only death flourishes.
"To comprehend the full answer requires years of temporal study. In short, they were now never born in the first place." —Teferi
"I can't protect everyone here. But those I can, I will." —Karn
Sometimes the strongest weapon you can hold in your hand is another hand.
